description: Predicts specialty-specific access gaps at the ZCTA level using community context features. Trained on merged ZIP-level context + specialty-level density data with per-specialty bottom-20% target definition.

features.zip_provider_share_of_state: float (0.0-1.0, share of state providers in this ZIP)
features.individual_provider_ratio: float (0.0-1.0, proportion of providers that are individuals)
features.organization_provider_ratio: float (0.0-1.0, proportion of providers that are organizations)
features.specialty_diversity: float (0.0-1.0, specialty diversity index for the ZIP)

inference_response_schema.access_gap_score: float (0.0-1.0, probability of being an access gap from predict_proba)
inference_response_schema.recommendation: string (actionable recruitment guidance based on score and top contributing features)
inference_response_schema.explanation: list of strings (top 2-3 contributing features from global feature importances)

target_definition: Bottom 20% of specialty_provider_density_per_1000 within each PRIMARY_TAXONOMY group
training_data_notes: Merged provider_network_ml_ready_specialty.csv (165K rows) with provider_network_ml_ready.csv ZIP context on area_id. 799 rows dropped for missing density. Per-specialty thresholds used.
